Clients include Casetify; collaborations with Everpress, Typosters, and ABC Dinamo. Active social following (IG @designbysalome) and sells art prints via DROOL. Email designbysalome@gmx.de confirmed via Google snippet from her About page. Junior to mid-level: ~4 years freelance post-graduation, solo practice, influencer-adjacent reach. Autonomy 2 (independent but early-career, lighter-weight for system lead work; strong for type/poster support). Work Status: Freelance confirmed by Behance, LinkedIn, Brand Identity interview, and Contra profile.
